**NCAA Men’s Basketball Final Four – Universities & Mascots**

| Year | University | Mascot (Nickname) | Mascot’s Official Name (if applicable) |
|------|------------|-------------------|----------------------------------------|

| | Texas Tech University | Red Raiders | Raider Red |
| | Villanova University | Wildcats | Villanova Wildcat |
| | Auburn University | Tigers | Aubie the Tiger |

| | University of Houston | Cougars | Claws |
| | Gonzaga University | Bulldogs | Spud the Bulldog |
| | Baylor University | Bears | Bruiser |
| **2022** | University of Kansas | Jayhawks | Big Jay |
| | Gonzaga University | Bulldogs | Spud the Bulldog |
| | University of Arkansas | Razorbacks | Tusk |
| | Villanova University | Wildcats | Villanova Wildcat |
| **2023** | University of Connecticut | Huskies | The Huskies (a dog mascot) |
| | Purdue University | Boilermakers | Boilermaker Bill |
| | University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill | Tar Heels | *No official mascot* – the team is “Tar Heels” |
| | San Diego State University | Aztecs | Aztec Warrior |

> **Notes**
> * The 2021 Final Four was held at the “Rogers Center” in Toronto, Canada, due to COVID‑19 restrictions.
> * Some schools, like Illinois and North Carolina, traditionally do not have a single official mascot; the nickname (e.g., “Fighting Illini,” “Tar Heels”) is used instead.
> * The mascots listed are the most commonly referenced or officially licensed names for each school’s athletic teams.
